title: Fieldwork singing and schooling in his youth
summary: Little field singing; Maxey contrasts his childhood, walking miles to school, with today's easier ways.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Do you remember any singing in the fields when people were working when you were young?

Well at the time when I was young coming along well there wasn't too much singing in the field Because after I got big enough to work in the field well it wasn't doing too much singing there wasn't as much I don't guess the world was as wise as 40 or I'll say 36 years ago the world wasn't as wise as it is now
What do you mean by that? What do you mean by that?

Well it's the everyday the world grow wise and weaker though What I mean by that is that there's plenty of things that people have learned to do 36 years ago they didn't know how to do So you can take it and say it like this just to look at a fold car Now a 1960 model fold and then turn around and look at a 1926 model fold and you see the difference So that folks to people's as wise as now than it was then So people wasn't as wise up on blues and different things they was now A boy would have to be probably 20 or 23 years old before his daddy would even line up to pick up a guitar But now we have schools that start small when he's big enough to hold a guitar to try to play But see in my days they didn't have that We would have walked sometimes five miles to school Walk there we didn't know nothing about it We didn't even have a wagon to ride in Take in school at 8 and stay at the 4 And walk back then get up wood and pine after we get in do up night work And then get your lesson and be ready for school the next morning But now the people's got wise and weak they don't do that
Goes on school buses have other ways to go
